research_notes: Rule for all cards: categories are assigned by merchant category code (MCC). Lumber/materials at Home Depot/Lowe's code as home improvement and get NO bonus on any Chase/Amex/Capital One/U.S. Bank/BofA card here; only the Lowe's 5% discount touches materials_home_improvement.
Amex Blue Business Cash/Plus: annual fee confirmed $0 via Amex compare page; foreign transaction fee and welcome offers load via JavaScript and were not captured.
Amex Business Gold welcome offer not captured (JS). Annual fee $375 confirmed.

Amex MR statement-credit value 0.6 cents is from Amex's own Credit Intel article (updated 2026-04-30), which illustrates with the Platinum card and says values vary by card; not confirmed card-specific for Blue Business Plus or Business Gold.
Capital One miles cash/erase value: NOT confirmed on any capitalone.com page (no cents-per-mile figure stated). Venture Business point_value_cash left null.
Chase Ink Unlimited and Ink Cash foreign transaction fees not shown on product pages (Ink Preferred confirmed none).
U.S. Bank Triple Cash foreign transaction fee not confirmed.
BofA: how often the Customized Cash 3% choice category can be changed was not confirmed from page text.

MyLowe's Pro Rewards point cash value not confirmed; Lowe's 5% discount cannot be combined with Contractor Pack, volume discounts or special/contract pricing, so for pros on volume pricing the 5% may not apply.
Graphite Business Cash Unlimited and Spark 2% Cash were not on the requested list but were found on issuer card lists and included as relevant flat-2% options; drop them if out of scope.

Portal/merchant-specific rates (Lyft, AmexTravel, Capital One Business Travel, U.S. Bank Travel Center) are kept in portal_or_merchant_specific_rules, NOT in earn_rules, so a calculator won't credit them to general 'travel' spend.
Welcome offers are recorded as notes only and must not be counted.
